steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...So I followed Falin into the cave.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Which is where I found out her 'secret.'

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: She also explained what 'ecology' was while we were there. It was the first time I realized how limited my experiences had been.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: That's the day she and I became best friends.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: What more can one ask for in life but a companion dear?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: From the way you talk about her, this Falin must be very important to you.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You're right. She's the closest friend I have.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Shouldn't you be looking for her, then?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I remember you telling me that she was eaten by a red dragon, but you have some means of reviving her.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Red dragon... Red...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We will save her. And once we do, I'll bring her back to P'o-shan to meet you!

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: There goes the bell again. That's rather frequent for one day.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It better not be Laios's fault!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'll go have a look!

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: *sigh* This... is about all I can do.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: It seems it's up to you to save your companions, Laios.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: What's the matter, Marcille?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's strange. The bell went off, but the ink spirits didn't attack.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios hasn't returned either.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Haha, if you like apricots, then go get 'em!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hup!
He throws a handful of apricots he picked into the distance and a pack of bestial ink spirits, large and small, chase after them.
Laios rejoices in watching them squabble over the fruit. Almost wanting to take the entire pack home to raise as dogs.
Right, they're just like Nussa, Anowtrid, Boff, Fucci, Dustrag, and Muimui!

steps.name: Gormless Ink Spirit
steps.text: Hraaagh—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No need to rush, plenty more to go around!
For the ink spirits that resemble sloths, Laios feels no need to make them fight over the fruits.
He's become familiar with the habits of this species of ink spirits, setting aside a pile of apricots just for them to eat as they please.
Once they eat their fill, they lie down, and the color of their backs begins to change...
As he watches them try to stuff their mouths despite their protruding, plump bellies, he wonders how anyone couldn't be fond of these little fellows.

steps.name: Relaxed Ink Spirit
steps.text: Aaaaaagh—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No need to worry. Did you think I forgot about you guys?
The tortoise-like ink spirits might be the species Laios is most interested in. At first, he thought they were giant rocks, at least until his butt made contact with its shell.
Their temperament is exactly the same as a tortoise. The most interesting thing about them is that once their appetites are sated, spring water begins to flow out the false mountains on their backs!
Thunder rumbles in the distance.
Upon hearing it, the ink spirits begin to stand, one by one.
Though they discover that they cannot, for one simple reason...
They've stuffed themselves silly!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye, looks like it's gonna be a good harvest this year.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: And it's all thanks to you, Senshi.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: If you weren't here, my harvest would only be about half as much!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: All I'm doing is putting my knowledge to good use.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Senshi, stop with the farming!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: What's wrong, Marcille?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's been days since Laios went off to look for ink spirits outside the village, and he hasn't returned!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Laios? Well, the lad's fond of research. Let him be.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The ink spirits haven't been attacking the village lately either...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Surely something's happened to him?!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Oh... Well, we were planning on staying here for long anyhow. No harm in waiting a bit longer.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: No, no... We can't stay here long!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: We need to go beat the Red Dragon and save Falin! Have you forgotten all that?!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Now that you mention it, Marcille, how long have we been in this village?

spans.text: Now that you mention it, Marcille, how long

steps.name: Ink Spirits
steps.text: Hrgh—!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hungry again?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: My oh my, you're greedy little fellows, aren't you?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No need to worry, plenty for everyone today too.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Though we're going to do something a bit different this time around.

steps.name: Gormless Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh—gkh?

steps.name: Lively Ink Spirit
steps.text: Hugkh?

steps.name: Relaxed Ink Spirit
steps.text: Hah—hoo...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: See the peak of that hill over there?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I put lots of your favorite fruit there.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: If you want to eat, you'll have to fight for it! It's one of the laws of nature!

steps.name: Ink Spirits
steps.text: GKH—GKH!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well, if everyone understands the rules, I'll start counting. Three, two, one...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Go! Get running!
The ink spirits start charging towards the hilltop on his command. All save for the tortoise-shaped ones, that is.

steps.name: Relaxed Ink Spirit
steps.text: Aaaaaagh—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh, you'd like me to sit? You really want me to ride you?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Haha, you're a smart one. You figured out that instead of fighting the others, you can just butter me up.

steps.name: Relaxed Ink Spirit
steps.text: Hoo—ahh...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Alright, alright. Here, have a bite.
Amidst the mounts, days pass like the wind.
By now, Laios has figured out it's the thunder that triggers the ink spirits to attack the village.
But external stimulus like that won't change their inherent habits. Laios knows this too well.
So why not lure them as far away from the village as possible with fruits?
That way, if they attack again, they'll have to run all the way from the top of the hill rather than halfway down!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Ahh... *hic*... This is some really good stuff...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What do you say, enough?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: No... No way!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Another cup, then.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Chilchuck!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Eh? What are you doin' here, Marcille?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Stop drinking already!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios has been gone for who knows how long!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The ink spirits haven't been attacking lately either.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: He must have done something!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Then let him do his thing, I'm drinking here.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Figures he'd be like us from just a bit earlier.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Right. He's practically a villager at this point.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Chilchuck, do you remember how long it's been since we arrived here?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Do you remember how we need to rescue Falin?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Do you remember those mimics you really really hated?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Ghh, gah, my head.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Is your memory coming back?!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Chilchuck, are you alright?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Gkh gkh gkh, gkh? (So, what're your names?)

steps.name: Gormless Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh gkh!

steps.name: Lively Ink Spirit
steps.text: Wuh!

steps.name: Relaxed Ink Spirit
steps.text: Aaaaaagh—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Gkh gkh gkh wuh! Laios! (I see now, your names are 'Bitey', 'Angry' and 'Lazy'? I'm Laios!)

steps.name: 'Bitey'
steps.text: Wuu gkh, gkh gkh!

steps.name: 'Angry'
steps.text: Gkh gkh gkhhh!

steps.name: 'Lazy'
steps.text: Hoo—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Gkh gkh huu gkh wuu gkh gkh! (Of course we're friends!)
Secluded in the mounts, Laios loses track of time.
He no longer cares if the thunder booms or not.
He's now good friends with the ink spirits. They eat together and live together. Every day, they pluck fresh fruits and frolic about in the hillside forest.
He even understands their speech—

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: You sure the lad's around here?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: No... But the ink spirits all came from this direction.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: If he's been researching them this whole time, I figured he'd be here.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: You said that ever since he came out here, the ink spirits haven't been attacking the village as much.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Maybe he did something to stop them?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: But I've got a sneaking suspicion he's run off to play with them god-knows-where...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You might be right... We'd better find him, quick!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Phew...
The longer Laios lives with them, the more he has come to understand these 'ink monsters.'

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I should head back and tell everyone about this.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: They'll be amazed! After all—

steps.name: 'Bitey'
steps.text: Gkh gkh?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Gkh gkh woo! (Come with me. I'll introduce you guys to my companions.)

steps.name: 'Angry'
steps.text: Wuu gkh—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wuu wuu gkh gkh! (Don't worry, they're good people. They won't harm you—)

steps.name: 'Lazy'
steps.text: Wuu—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Gkh—gkh— (Yeah, I'm sure they'll welcome you all!)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios, we're here to help—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: you...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh?
The three rescuers see a most bizarre scene.
Laios, the one they’ve been worried about and eagerly searching for...
is crawling around on all fours like a wild animal, talking to the ink spirits in an incomprehensible language.
It was at that moment that they felt something shatter in their hearts.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wuu gkh gkh! (Oh, you guys came at just the right time!)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wha...?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh, sorry. I've been using their language for so long, I nearly forgot how to speak to humans.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...Sorry to have bothered you. We'll be on our way.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hey, don't go, I've got some real important discoveries to tell you!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Oh, no, no need. We'll find our own way out and let you live out your dream here.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I was gonna say I learned something about how to leave.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...You learned what now?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Just watch.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hey guys, it's lunch time!

steps.name: Ink Spirits
steps.text: Gkh—! (Happily scramble to each and every pile of fruit)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Did... Did you tame them with all this fruit?

steps.name: 'Bitey'
steps.text: Hraaagh—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: They're changing color!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: That's one of its traits. Bitey changes color when it's full.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's called Bitey?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Mhm. The one that looks like a small dog is Angry, and the tortoise-shaped one is Lazy.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Did you name them?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No, they told me.

steps.name: 'Bitey'
steps.text: Gkh, gkh—blurgh—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eurgh, this one's eaten so much it puked! And the vomit's so colorful, it's kinda sickening—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hmm? Wait, that smell... Is that... alcohol...?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What are you doing, Senshi?! That's ink spirit puke!

spans.text: What are you doing, Senshi?! That's ink spirit

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Smells like fruit wine. Hmm... A good ferment, if my nose is right.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Tastes pretty good, too.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Don't just eat random things!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Calm down, Marcille. Listen.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Listen for what?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: The sound of what's sloshing around in their bellies. This one has wine inside, while this one has jam.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...And?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Keep looking.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye, this one's got gushing springs on its back after eating all that fruit. Hmm... This... Oh my, how refreshing. It's fruit juice!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What does any of this have to do with getting out of here?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wait a moment and you'll see.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Senshi, do you have any containers we can keep the jam and drinks in?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I do. I've been drinking with the villagers a whole lot recently, so I got a few cups and bottles on me.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Don't tell me you're thinking of...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Don't tell me you want to...!!!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Nicely done, though this jam will need some sugar if you want it to be palatable.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: As for the juice... It's refreshing, sure, but a bit bland.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: But if we blend the juices that go well together...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Add in some sugar, stir it until it's mixed evenly...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Pour into a glass, add fruit slices for decoration, and... It's done!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: My improved ink spirit wine, jam, and juice! Give it a try!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Oh, this fruit wine really does have new flavors to it.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Bit too much sugar for one day, though. We should get some exercise to work it off.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I really don't want to speak with people who are willing to eat vomit...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Honey is bee vomit, Marcille.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: The vegetables I grow on the golems are also fertilized with excrement from people in the dungeon—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Stop! I don't wanna hear it!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What's up, Laios? You haven't said a word since earlier.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I'll tell you all my plans now.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: When I was chasing that ink spirit with the mole, I was surprised to discover that they'd happily slack off from attacking the village if it meant they got to eat fruit instead.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Which means...?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Monsters do attack humans, and sometimes that is due to their aggressive nature...

spans.text: Monsters do attack humans, and sometimes that

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But most of the time there's a specific reason, like their habitat getting encroached upon, or something happened that enraged them.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But there's no reason why they attacked the village. At first I thought it was out of hunger, but these guys are far too docile and meek when they eat to back it up.

steps.name: 'Angry'
steps.text: Gkh?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Yeah... That one's even dripping with spit.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Then there's the villagers. It's incredibly strange how they have absolutely no understanding of ink spirit behavior.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We've only just arrived and I've already found out you can tame them with fruit. But the villagers have clashed with them countless times. They should've learned a thing or two about handling them, even if they didn't want to.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But they haven't. It's like they have no need for it.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Maybe they tried before, but didn't learn the proper way?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: That'd be even stranger. If they tried and failed, wouldn't it make more sense to just leave this dangerous place? Obviously, they chose to stay, so wouldn't they want to keep trying to fend them off?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: They won't leave and they won't find a way to fend them off. So how are they still living here?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And haven't you guys ever wondered why we couldn't find an ink spirit 'nest'?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What's more, they can come back to life endlessly. It's as if... this whole place is fake.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Oh? What an interesting theory.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Dawn? When did you...?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Please, do go on.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Where we come from, legend speaks of a 'lunatic magician,' who used his tremendous magical power to create a dungeon.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: All sorts of monsters live within it.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But their existence isn't isolated, but interconnected. They prey on, exploit, and sometimes form symbiosis with one another...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: They're all part of one ecosystem.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No matter what kind of man this lunatic magician is, I can tell just how amazing of a feat that was. As for this place...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Someone who could create such a vivid, life-like world must be amazing as well.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But...

steps.name: 'Bitey'
steps.text: (Drooling and smacking its lips)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I wonder... why didn't this person design a more complete ecosystem when creating the ink spirits?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Where do they build their nests? How do they reproduce? How do different variations communicate with one another? And what's their relationship to the people who live here?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I'm so curious about all this, but I don't see how all the pieces fit together. Why did that person make things this way?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: And there's one more thing I noticed.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: They hid away a basket of hawthorn berries, but never once ate from it.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: ...Hawthorn?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: (Whispers) Hawthorn, is it...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: (Whispers) I never noticed.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Sorry, what was that?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Nothing, just thinking aloud is all.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: But... I see now.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: The connection between all things, which you deem important, serves as a mutual affirmation of one another. I am your mirror, and you mine. This is the 'truth' as you understand it.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Marcille, how come I don't understand a word of what those two are saying?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Uh... Umm... I'd love to agree with you, but I think I can understand them a liiiittle bit...

spans.text: Uh... Umm... I'd love to agree with you, but I
I can understand them a liiiittle bit...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: *burst of laughter* Interesting, very interesting.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You are right. All things adhere to logic. As with all the other myriad forms of life within a painting, so too must ink spirits have a place to come from, and a place to go.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I suppose rootless weeds such as them would be flaws in reality.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: There have been a few who were able to discern that they were in no more than a painting, but... It's been quite a while since someone explained their reasoning with such conviction.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Perhaps this can be seen as another way of saying 'the mountains are but mountains, and the water is yet water.'?
After saying that, for some unknown reason, she turns and looks up at the sky.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: He has seen the truth beyond the veil of wonder, no?
Huh?
What's happened to this painting?!
I painted a perfectly good landscape on this! Why is it all like this now?
The ugly ink blots, the water stain, and the blotches of red and purple... Did someone sneak into my room?
Could it have been...
No, this time it isn't the work of my 'lovely sister'...
How interesting. Perhaps there is an unruly spirit roaming the wilds with a penchant for artistry.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Whoa! I think the whole mountain shook with that thunder.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Oh dear. It seems you've made her truly angry.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What? Who? Who's angry?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: And no wonder, what with all the ink spirits you lured over, and how you got them so drunk they can barely even stand. This is the first time I've seen them like this.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Dawn, what are you talking about?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Look! Up there! Someone's... falling out of the sky?!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Uhh... more like flying... and she looks pissed! Maybe she's the magician who created this place?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Awawawah! Laios must have made her mad with his blabbering!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What?! But I didn't say anything wrong!

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: No need to panic. She's not here to harm you, just... consider it a unique way to send you on your way.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: The ink spirits are simply her distracting thoughts, and as such, I hope you understand why she didn't feel the need to organize them properly.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hey! Be gentle with them! They've just eaten, you can't lift them upside-down like that!

steps.name: 'Bitey'
steps.text: Gkh—blurghh—

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Quick, take this bottle and fill it up with that jam! Don't let it go to waste!
Get—out—NOW!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wha-wha-what?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: How are you drawing with that sw—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: —orrrrrrrrdAHHHH—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: —Ow! My butt!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Eeeek!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: How did we... Are you guys alright?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*...I'm here. Still alive.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I'm alright too.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hmm... I can smell the sea.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Are we close to the coast?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I don't know, but at the very least, we've gotten out of that place. Probably.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No, wait, I didn't even have time to say goodbye to them!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I guess things really did work out thanks to Laios's love of monsters.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wait, Marcille, your mouth...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Why's it all black?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You couldn't stop yourself from trying some earlier, could you?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Mmwuh? ...Wait, it's the same with you guys!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Puh! Pfah! Pfeh! Pfoo! What is this taste?

spans.text: Puh! Pfah! Pfeh! Pfoo! What is this

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What did we just eat?!

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Looks like this painting's got to go.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I thought they were an amusing bunch. Not going to try some? There are some hawthorn berries here too.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Not even a bite?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Absolutely not!
